var_dir.description: Base directory for Mailman’s persistent data (archives, lists, etc.)

pid_file.description: Path to the master process PID file

default_language.description: Default language code for new users and list messages (e.g., 'en', 'fr')

outgoing_charset.description: Default character set for outgoing email messages

email_host.description: Default domain suffix for list addresses (e.g., 'lists.example.com' → lists@lists.example.com)

web_host.description: Public hostname used for the web UI and list pages

list_max_members.description: Maximum number of members allowed per mailing list

max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) for messages accepted from posters (default: 10 MB)

subscription_policy.description: Policy for new subscriptions: 'confirm' (email confirmation), 'notify' (admin notified), 'moderate' (admin approval required), 'direct' (auto-approve), or 'digest'

post_hold_policy.description: Policy for posts from non-members: 'moderate' (hold for approval), 'reject' (discard), 'discard' (discard silently), or 'accept' (allow)

auto_subscribe.description: Whether to auto-subscribe a poster’s email address if they post but are not yet a list member

require_subject.description: Whether to reject posts lacking a Subject: header

footer_msg.description: Footer text appended to every outgoing list message (leave empty to disable)

api_rate_limit.description: Maximum number of REST API requests per minute per IP (for rate limiting)

password_reset_timeout.description: Time window (in seconds) during which a password reset token is valid

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname for outgoing mail

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (587 for submission, 465 for SMTPS, 25 for unencrypted)

smtp_user.description: SMTP username (leave empty if no authentication needed)

smtp_pass.description: SMTP password (store securely in production — e.g., via secrets manager)

smtp_use_tls.description: Whether to use STARTTLS for SMTP (required on port 587)

smtp_use_ssl.description: Whether to use implicit SSL/TLS for SMTP (port 465)

smtp_local_domain.description: Domain name advertised to the SMTP server (for HELO/EHLO)

mail_in_backends.description: List of mail-in backends (e.g., IMAP/POP3 for fetching mail from external accounts)

password.description: Password for IMAP/POP (store securely — consider using environment variables or secret manager)

mta_backends.description: List of MTA backends to interface with system mail servers

name.description: Unique name for this MTA backend

args.description: List of arguments passed to the MTA command

db_class.description: Database backend class — use 'mailman.database.postgres.PostgresDatabase' for production

db_url.description: Database URL — SQLite path (e.g., '/var/lib/mailman3/mailman.db') or PostgreSQL URI (e.g., 'postgresql://mailman:pass@localhost/mailman')

rest_endpoint.description: Local address and port where the REST API is exposed (e.g., '127.0.0.1:8001')

rest_api_key.description: API key used by Mailman Core to authenticate to the REST API (e.g., generated via 'mailman mta -g')

mta_incoming.description: Name of the MTA backend used to receive incoming mail

mta_outgoing.description: Name of the MTA backend used to send outgoing mail

log_level.description: Default logging level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use if logging to syslog (e.g., daemon, local0)

hyperkitty_enable.description: Whether to enable the Hyperkitty archiver (web archive)

hyperkitty_endpoint.description: Base URL of the Hyperkitty web service

hyperkitty_api_key.description: API key for authenticating with Hyperkitty (must match Hyperkitty’s MAILMAN_ARCHIVER_API_KEY)

mbox_archiver_enable.description: Whether to enable the local mbox archiver (Maildir-style)

mbox_archiver_path.description: Base directory for local mbox archives

mbox_archiver_compress.description: Whether to compress archived mbox files

secret_key.description: Secret key used for cryptographic signing of cookies and tokens (generate with 'openssl rand -base64 42')

secure_cookies.description: Whether to set cookies as Secure (HTTPS-only) — enable in production behind HTTPS
